decisions.reason: The DPA management tool keeps its own page, has positive agency-focused feedback with nearly 200 templates, and fits GDPR compliance demand, so it is likely retained.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page in both years and appears to be the firm's core offering.
The configurable managed hosting plan has had its own page consistently and complements the core hosting platform, generating recurring revenue.
Extended PHP security support is a low-cost add-on serving customers on legacy PHP versions, though its only-mentioned status and time-limited relevance add some risk.
